workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: Instructional contracts shall be for a period of one hundred and ninety-eight (198) days.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 7 hours and 30 minutes on regular school days; 7 hours on non-student days
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: Unless otherwise agreed to by the parties, the regular school day for teachers is seven (7) hours and thirty (30) minutes. The regular school day on days when students are not in attendance, such as in-service, preschool, post-school, and staff development days, is seven (7) hours.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: Uninterrupted Planning: This is time reserved for the teacher to use at their professional discretion for work-related activities.

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Elementary: 30 min during student day + 2 hrs outside per week. Secondary/Postsecondary: 1 period during student day + 2 hrs outside per week (or 330 min/week if block scheduling makes the above unworkable).
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: each elementary teacher shall have a minimum of thirty (30) minutes of Uninterrupted Planning during the Student Instructional Day and the equivalent of two (2) hours per week outside the Student Instructional Day. Each secondary and full-time postsecondary school teacher shall have one (1) full period or its equivalent of Uninterrupted Planning Time during the Student Instructional Day and two (2) hours per week outside the Student Instructional Day. Where the subject taught is organized in such blocks of time as to make this provision unworkable without seriously hampering the instructional program, teachers shall receive no less than three hundred thirty (330) minutes of Uninterrupted Planning Time per week.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: No teacher shall be required to forfeit Uninterrupted Planning Time on a regular or continuing basis.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: Lunch times are to be free from assigned duties or supervising students.
